Looks good with a nice theme :D

1. Maybe make the island a little bigger for more space
2. Probably take out the void or either create maybe a 1 - 2 block ditch in below the bridge which is has water (place water then but blue stained glass over so it looks/is a water theme but for pvp purposes there is no water)
3. Reduce the amount of arrows to like 8? bow spamming on frenzy with 1 life... xD

Apart from that it looks good and should play quite well if you make some changes <3
